messages.author: 000b017cd3376202
messages.subject: ylab in ggplot
parts:
Hi,
using ggplot, I want to put the ylab horizontally on top of the y-axis
without specifying every time the position of the legend.

e.g.

df<-data.frame(a=runif(100), b=rnorm(100))

qplot(x=a, y=b, data=df)+geom_text(aes(0, 5), label="JJ")

In this case, I would like do not specify (0,5) but I would like the
ylab to be always on top of ylab

thanks

filippo
